overview: Players tell the admins what went wrong, or what could be better, without leaving the game.

1.3.2: Blocks touching only at a corner hold each other up, so the edges of diagonal builds are no longer flagged as floating.
1.3.1: Maintainer sessions release a fix through the index, and take a nameless message as a logged-in maintainer.
1.3.0: /mess reports grief or a mess where the player stands, and the mod cleans the pillars, splotches, floating clumps, spills, fire and TNT it can tell are mess.
Ops clean the rest with /issues clean, and /issues undo puts any cleaning back.
With paude set up and onMess on investigate or fix, a Claude session takes what the mod left.
1.2.3: Drop changelog notes for changes nothing in the game shows.
1.2.2: Ops close a report, or reopen it, and /issues lists only the open ones.
1.2.0: A crash the server comes back from is saved as a bug report from the server, unless onCrash is off.
With paude set up too, a Claude session looks into the crash, and may fix it and restart the server with the fix.
1.1.1: While a maintainer reads a Claude session in chat, paude shows them as there, by their player name.
1.1.0: Maintainers the server names can start a Claude session about a report and talk to it in chat.
1.0.0: /bug and /idea take a line from any player; /issues reads the latest back to an op.
Each report keeps the time, who sent it, where they stood and the block they looked at.
One line at a time to a file any editor can read. Stock clients can report.
